claims.text: Total revenue increased by 114.20% from $60,922 million in the year ended January 28, 2024, to $130,497 million in the year ended January 26, 2025.

The SEGMENT_04 segment's revenue grew by 145.11% from $47,405 million in the year ended January 28, 2024, to $116,193 million in the year ended January 26, 2025, driven by strong demand for accelerated computing and AI solutions, specifically a 162% growth in Data Center computing revenue and a 51% growth in Data Center networking revenue.

The SEGMENT_05 segment's revenue increased by 5.82% from $13,517 million in the year ended January 28, 2024, to $14,304 million in the year ended January 26, 2025, primarily due to sales of PRODUCT_25 GPUs, but its operating income decreased due to a 44% increase in segment operating expenses.

The company faces risks from increasing economic sanctions and export controls, which cannot disrupt supply chains. These restrictions could negatively impact demand for products and lead to excess inventory or supply charges, potentially benefiting competitors (Item 1A).

initial_report.rationale: The company demonstrated significant revenue growth, primarily driven by its SEGMENT_04 segment, which saw a 145.11% increase in revenue due to strong demand for AI and accelerated computing solutions. The overall revenue increased by 114.20%. However, the SEGMENT_05 segment, while experiencing a 5.82% revenue increase, saw a decrease in operating income due to a 44% increase in operating expenses. Furthermore, the company faces material risks from export controls and economic sanctions, which could negatively impact demand, disrupt supply chains, and increase compliance burdens. Given the strong growth in one segment offset by challenges in another and significant external risks, a HOLD recommendation is appropriate.

SEGMENT_04 revenue – The year over year increase was due to strong demand for our accelerated computing and AI solutions. Revenue from Data
Center computing grew 162% driven primarily by demand for our PRODUCT_23 computing platform used for large language models, recommendation engines, and
generative AI applications. Revenue from Data Center networking grew 51% driven by Ethernet for AI revenue, which includes PRODUCT_24 end-to-end ethernet
platform.
SEGMENT_05 revenue – The year over year increase was driven by sales of our PRODUCT_25 GPUs.
Reportable segment operating income – The year over year increase in SEGMENT_04 segment operating income was driven by growth in revenue. The
year over year decrease in SEGMENT_05 segment operating income was driven by an increase of 44% in segment operating expenses, partially offset by growth in
revenue.
All Other operating loss – The year over year increase was due to an increase in stock-based compensation expense reflecting employee growth and
compensation increases.

Export controls could disrupt our supply chain and distribution channels, negatively impacting our ability to serve demand, including in markets outside China
and for our gaming products. The possibility of additional export controls has negatively impacted and may in the future negatively impact demand for our
products, benefiting competitors that offer alternatives less likely to be restricted by further controls. Repeated changes in the export control rules are likely to
impose compliance burdens on our business and our customers, negatively and materially impacting our business.
Increasing use of economic sanctions and export controls has impacted and may in the future impact demand for our products or services, negatively impacting
our business and financial results. Reduced demand due to export controls could also lead to excess inventory or cause us to incur related supply charges.
